name: How does a roof deck assessment differ from a standard roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: How does a roof deck assessment differ from a standard roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard roof inspection primarily focuses on the condition of the visible roofing materials, like shingles or membranes, for leaks or wear. A roof deck assessment, however, delves deeper to evaluate the structural components beneath the roofing material. While a standard inspection might note potential issues, a deck assessment provides a definitive understanding of the sub-structure's health, which is critical for budgeting and planning major repairs or replacements, especially in areas with varying weather like the DFW metroplex.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard roof inspection checks visible roofing materials, while a roof deck assessment evaluates the structural components beneath for underlying issues.
